title: rea evidence record
description: One reverse-engineer-anything evidence record written by the rea_ledger.write op: a located observation supporting or contesting one claim. Claude-Klabauter-owned (example-retrieval-repo conforms to it). Every field is required and nulls are explicit so canonical re-serialisation is total. id is the ledger filename stem.

id.description: Unique record id; the op uses it as the filename stem, so it carries no path separator.

claim_id.description: id of the claim this record bears on.

source_ref.description: Path, URL, command line or document name the observation came from.

locator.description: Position inside source_ref (line range, anchor, page); null when the whole source is the evidence.

excerpt.description: Verbatim text observed; null when none was captured.

observed_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the observation, digested as emitted (no normalisation).

observer.description: Session or agent id that made the observation.
